text: General health medical camps provide basic check-ups for all age groups.
Specialized dental and eye clinics are organized periodically.
Doctors check blood pressure and blood glucose levels during regular camps.
Nutritional support is provided for pregnant and lactating mothers.
Voluntary blood donation drives are conducted in rural community centers.
A common emitter transistor amplifier provides high voltage and current gain.
The frequency response of the operational amplifier depends on the feedback loop.
Binary phase shift keying modulation offers superior noise immunity compared to amplitude modulation.
Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing reduces intersymbol interference in multipath channels.
The microcontroller executes instructions stored in non-volatile flash memory.
